recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the stale build-source mapping without duplicating text, and no further core source change is needed for MessageHeader-event or MessageDefinition-event because their current event search expressions select Coding or canonical and canonical already maps to token.
issue_request: FHIR-25172 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core MessageHeader. The revised resolution asked to update the search summary table so the primitive type uri maps to search parameter type token, with the token system left blank and the pipe form not used.
initial_application: The issue had partial historical application. FHIR-I first discussed token use for uri with an urn:ietf:rfc:3986 system, then reopened the issue in 2021 to remove the system/pipe conflict. The explicit Jira-tagged commit 69e9b87769 changed canonical=reference,uri to canonical=reference,uri,token in source/fhir.ini, which aligned current MessageHeader.event[x] and MessageDefinition.event[x] after their URI choices became canonical, but it did not add token to the primitive uri mapping.
additional_context: Current source/search.html already contains the <%xcm uri:token%> summary-table macro cell, and the token section already says token searches on uri elements do not use the pipe form. The current build output still rendered primitive uri/token as N because the active source/fhir.ini [search-rules] entry remained uri=uri,reference. Confluence minutes and Zulip discussion confirm that the intended source material was the search-rule mapping used by that macro.
reconciliation: Changed source/fhir.ini [search-rules] from uri=uri,reference to uri=uri,reference,token. This is the build-scope source that drives the existing search.html summary-table macro, so no additional narrative or search parameter expression change was needed.
source_changes: source/fhir.ini: changed the active [search-rules] entry for uri from uri,reference to uri,reference,token.
